description: Delete (soft-delete) one of the USER'S OWN listings by listing_id: it leaves the marketplace and cannot be restored through these tools. Use it ONLY when the user clearly asks to delete the listing. If they say "take it down", "pause it" or "I sold it", use set_listing_status (hidden or sold) instead — that is reversible. Ask for confirmation when the request is ambiguous. Only the owner can delete. No credit is refunded — the listing was already published. Returns { success: true } when the listing was deleted.

listing_id.description: Listing id, taken from the `id` field of search_listings, semantic_search or list_my_listings results. Example: "adzuna-us-5947308680".

name: delete_listing
